111:     Build DataLoaders for training, validation, and testing.
112:     Resets training samples for each epoch to ensure proper data shuffling.
113: 
114:     Args:
115:         epoch: Current epoch number
116:         train_dataset_raw: Raw training dataset
117:         valid_dataset_raw: Raw validation dataset
118:         test_dataset_raw: Raw test dataset

120:         configs: Configuration object

122:         use_features: Whether to use feature embeddings
123:         encoding_scheme: Encoding scheme for the input embeddings ('full', 'adjacency_row', or 'edge_list')
124:         is_gnn: Whether the model is a GNN model (default: False)
125: 
126:     Returns:
127:         tuple: (train_loader, valid_loader, test_loader)
128:     """
129:     # For GNN models, use raw dataset directly with GNNCollator
130:     if is_gnn:
131:         if train_dataset_raw is not None:
132:             train_dataset_raw.reset_samples(epoch=epoch, seed=configs.seed)
133:             train_g = torch.Generator()
134:             train_g.manual_seed(configs.seed * 100 + epoch)
135:             train_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
136:                 train_dataset_raw,
137:                 batch_size=configs.batch_size_training,
138:                 num_workers=configs.num_workers,
139:                 pin_memory=True,
140:                 shuffle=False,  # Shuffling handled by DistributedSampler
141:                 sampler=DistributedSampler(train_dataset_raw, shuffle=True),
142:                 collate_fn=collator,
143:                 generator=train_g,
144:                 worker_init_fn=lambda worker_id: seed_worker(
145:                     worker_id, configs.seed * 100 + epoch
146:                 ),
147:             )
148:             train_loader.sampler.set_epoch(epoch)
149:         else:
150:             train_loader = None
151: 
152:         g = torch.Generator()
153:         g.manual_seed(configs.seed)
154: 
155:         if valid_dataset_raw is not None:
156:             valid_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
157:                 valid_dataset_raw,
158:                 batch_size=configs.batch_size_training,
159:                 num_workers=configs.num_workers,
160:                 pin_memory=True,
161:                 shuffle=False,
162:                 sampler=DistributedSampler(valid_dataset_raw, shuffle=False),
163:                 collate_fn=collator,
164:                 generator=g,
165:                 worker_init_fn=lambda worker_id: seed_worker(worker_id, configs.seed),
166:             )
167:         else:
168:             valid_loader = None
169: 
170:         if test_dataset_raw is not None:
171:             test_loader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
172:                 test_dataset_raw,
173:                 batch_size=configs.batch_size_training,
174:                 num_workers=configs.num_workers,
175:                 pin_memory=True,
176:                 shuffle=False,
177:                 sampler=DistributedSampler(test_dataset_raw, shuffle=False),
178:                 collate_fn=collator,
179:                 generator=g,
180:                 worker_init_fn=lambda worker_id: seed_worker(worker_id, configs.seed),
181:             )
182:         else:
183:             test_loader = None
184: 
185:         return train_loader, valid_loader, test_loader
